description: Agent-native product catalog API. v2 tool surface (search_products_v2, get_product_v2, compare_products_v2, find_best_price_v2, get_deals_v2) requires the end-user's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code as `deliver_to` on every search/price/deals call, so results are ranked for products your user can actually receive with per-row availability. Covers 7+ merchants across Singapore and the United States. Free tier: 1,000 calls/month. Get an API key at https://buywhere.ai/api-keys. Migration guide: https://api.buywhere.ai/docs/agent-dx

tools.name: search_products_v2
tools.description: Search the BuyWhere product catalog by keyword. v2 REQUIRES `deliver_to` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. SG, US, MY) so results are ranked for the end user's market with per-row availability.

tools.name: get_product_v2
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a specific BuyWhere product by ID. v2 mirrors v1 plus per-row availability for the scoped market.

tools.name: compare_products_v2
tools.description: Compare 2–10 products side-by-side across merchants. v2 lets callers scope the comparison to a market via `deliver_to`.

tools.name: get_deals_v2
tools.description: Find products with significant price drops, deliverability-filtered. v2 REQUIRES `deliver_to`.

tools.name: find_best_price_v2
tools.description: Find the cheapest deliverable listing for a product across covered merchants. v2 REQUIRES `deliver_to`.

tooling.live_surface_until_v2_ships: v1 (search_products, get_product, compare_products, find_best_price, get_deals, list_categories)
